docs.text:
name: PlantTissueSample
description: Plant tissue sample metadata including collection, taxonomic, and environmental
  information
from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
attributes:
  id:
    name: id
    description: Sample ID (No Edit) - prefilled identifier
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:identifier
    identifier: true
    alias: id
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: integer
  sample_container:
    name: sample_container
    description: Select tube or plate
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: sample_container
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: SampleContainerEnum
    required: true
  plate_location:
    name: plate_location
    description: Required if samples provided in a plate. For partial plates, fill
      by columns. Leave blank if the sample will be shipped in a tube (e.g., B1)
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: plate_location
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: string
    pattern: ^[A-H][1-9][0-2]?$
  strain_variety_cultivar:
    name: strain_variety_cultivar
    description: Name or ID of the cultivar, variety, strain, or other similar designation
      of the primary organism being sampled
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: strain_variety_cultivar
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: string
    required: true
  isolate:
    name: isolate
    description: Isolate or mutant name
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: isolate
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: string
  ncbi_taxonomy_id:
    name: ncbi_taxonomy_id
    description: Unique identifier from the NCBI taxonomy database
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: ncbi_taxonomy_id
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: NCBITaxonEnum
    required: true
  ploidy:
    name: ploidy
    description: The ploidy level of the genome (e.g. allopolyploid, haploid, diploid,
      triploid, tetraploid). For terms, select terms listed under class ploidy (PATO:001374)
      of Phenotypic Quality Ontology (PATO)
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    exact_mappings:
    - PATO:0001374
    - NCIT:C17001
    - SIO:010278
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: PATO:0001374
    alias: ploidy
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: PloidyEnum
  collection_date_time:
    name: collection_date_time
    description: The time of sampling, either as an instance (single point in time)
      or interval. In case no exact time is available, the date/time can be right
      truncated. All times must be I SO8601 compliant
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: collection_date_time
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: datetime
    required: true
  sample_size:
    name: sample_size
    description: The total amount or size (volume (ml), mass (g) or area (m2)) of
      sample collected. Separate the number and unit by a single space
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: sample_size
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: string
    required: true
    pattern: ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s+(g|ml|m2)$
  tissue:
    name: tissue
    description: Detailed description of the organ or type of tissue sampled (e.g.
      unopened flower buds with 1mm petal visible, 5 mm lateral root tips, 4th leaf
      fully expanded)
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: tissue
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: string
    required: true
  tissue_plant_ontology_term:
    name: tissue_plant_ontology_term
    description: Plant ontology term corresponding to plant structure sampled. May
      include multiple terms separated by semicolons. See https://planteome.org
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: tissue_plant_ontology_term
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: TissueTypeEnum
  depth_meters:
    name: depth_meters
    description: The vertical distance (in meters) below local surface. For sediment
      or soil samples depth is measured from sediment or soil surface, respectively.
      Depth can be reported as an interval for subsurface samples
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: depth_meters
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: float
  elevation_meters:
    name: elevation_meters
    description: Elevation (in meters) of the sampling site as measured by the vertical
      distance from mean sea level
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: elevation_meters
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: float
  broad_scale_environmental_context:
    name: broad_scale_environmental_context
    description: The major environmental system the sample or specimen came from.
      The system(s) identified should have a coarse spatial grain, to provide the
      big contextualising environment of where the sampling was done (e.g. in the
      desert or a rainforest). See https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo/wiki/Using-ENVO-with-MIxS
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: broad_scale_environmental_context
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: uriorcurie
  local_environmental_context:
    name: local_environmental_context
    description: The entity or entities which are in the sample or specimen's local
      vicinity and which you believe have significant causal influences on your sample
      or specimen. The terms used here should be countable things (e.g. a rock, a
      snow crystal, a cave, a hydrothermal vent) of smaller spatial grain than your
      entry for broad-scale environmental context. See https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo/wiki/Using-ENVO-with-MIxS
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: local_environmental_context
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: uriorcurie
  environmental_medium:
    name: environmental_medium
    description: The environmental material(s) immediately surrounding the sample
      or specimen at the time of sampling. These should be mass/volume nouns (e.g.
      air, water) and not discrete, countable entities (e.g. a tree, a leaf, a table
      top). See https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo/wiki/Using-ENVO-with-MIxS
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/linkml/linkml-tutorial-2025
    rank: 1000
    alias: environmental_medium
    owner: PlantTissueSample
    domain_of:
    - PlantTissueSample
    range: uriorcurie

docs.title: Slot: local_environmental_context
docs.text:
The entity or entities which are in the sample or specimen's local vicinity and which you believe have significant causal influences on your sample or specimen. The terms used here should be countable things (e.g. a rock, a snow crystal, a cave, a hydrothermal vent) of smaller spatial grain than your entry for broad-scale environmental context. See https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo/wiki/Using-ENVO-with-MIxS
